name: Shelfarr
description: Shelfarr is a self-hosted ebook and audiobook request and management system for the *arr ecosystem. Users request titles, Shelfarr searches Prowlarr, Jackett or Newznab indexers and direct sources, sends the release to a download client, and delivers the finished book to Audiobookshelf.

notes.text: The first account registered at http://IP:5056 becomes the admin.
Library and download folders are set in Shelfarr's own settings. Add the mount points for audiobooks, ebooks and the download client's completed folder to the container before configuring them.

The database, the generated secret key and the encryption keys live in /opt/shelfarr/storage and /opt/shelfarr/.env. Losing the encryption keys makes stored indexer and download-client credentials unreadable, so include both in container backups.
Installation compiles Ruby and precompiles assets; allow several minutes for setup.
The optional Libation companion for Audible backups is a separate service and is not installed; that integration stays idle.
